Subject: Project Delivery Update - New Date of 14 April

I'm writing to give you a clear update on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for certification took longer to clear than the vendor's original estimate, which has pushed the schedule back by two weeks. As a result, we now expect to deliver the completed project on 14 April.

Our team has been working closely with the vendor throughout this process to keep the certification moving and to prevent any further slippage. We have also reviewed the remaining tasks in the plan and confirmed that no other dependencies are at risk, so the revised date reflects a realistic and stable target rather than a temporary estimate.

Does the new delivery date of 14 April still work with your internal planning, or would you like us to arrange a call to walk through the revised schedule in detail?
